Construct A74 V.VaultGitRepository(repo, ref=V.VAULT_REF). Call V.list_originals('2026-11', repo, source_commit=VAULT_STORAGE_COMMIT, run_id=44218343091, transport=git); filter kind SOURCE_CAPTURES.

Authenticate each selected batch/header with the existing _batch_entry helper and existing Actions-local MAC derivation. Require summary run_id=44218343091 and head_sha=A74. Headers contain each capture-NNNN.raw member SHA256, permitting a hash-only candidate prefilter before downloading ciphertext chunks.

Call unchanged V.restore_capture_bundle(locator, repo, transport=git) for candidate bundles. It returns {'captures':[(raw_bytes,metadata_raw_bytes),...], 'provenance':...}; bytes remain private in Actions memory.

Match each restored receipt/body to the already-authenticated wanted source SHA and private same-race URL identity. For a direct exact native URL require equality; for a known observed query-free locator require existing locator(receipt.source_url,'racelist',authenticated_race)==stored_locator, never reconstruct a URL. Compare aware captured_at when supplied. Repeated identical matches across snapshots deduplicate; missing clocks are not inferred and conflicting matches HOLD.

Do not call any retain/publish/write API, provider URL or model prediction/learning API. Failed index/batch/chunk/AES/receipt reads produce separate HOLD/null, not verified missing or zero.

source_ref_binding.relative_root: P is the admitted forecast partition payload; N=P['native_payload']; I=unchanged descriptor['info']; group=existing registry.group for its cell. Only forecast pairs contributing existing first-version descriptors are targets.
source_ref_binding.common_direct_proof: For groups with direct evidence, N['source_evidence'][*] carries source_ref/source_sha256/captured_at. Select only an exact same-race racelist request accepted by existing locator(...,'racelist',race); do not recursively search arbitrary objects. Identical duplicate proofs deduplicate; absent/ambiguous/conflicting direct proofs HOLD except the explicitly supported observed query-free form below.

paths.raw_program_sha: N['snapshot']['sources'][j]['source_sha256'], where source_id equals snapshot.race_source_id; source_url is the known query-free racelist locator
paths.raw_ref: Stored source ['source_url'] is deliberately QUERY-FREE, not a full request URL. Obtain the exact URL only from authenticated matching N/source original source_evidence when present or from the restored capture receipt; require existing locator(receipt_url,'racelist',authenticated_race)==stored query-free locator.
paths.old_original_wrapper: If the already-admitted observed N carries original_native_payload/original_input_sha256, use the explicitly validated original copy for original-source refs; keep existing digest/race/cutoff/roster guards. Baseline originals can also retain exact request source_evidence. Additional all-model observed inputs can be snapshot-only; their query-free source+SHA+clock binds a restored receipt via the existing locator function. No generic recursive unwrapping or URL construction.

source_ref_binding.unsupported: Seller/P0 B-LZH, non-BOAT, unknown groups/schema variants, absent or ambiguous direct refs remain separately HOLD/unsupported; no guessed program URL or blanket field fallback.
never_raw_body_SHA: P['source_sha256'] and pair.input_sha256 are hashes of the native JSON payload
descriptor.record_sha256 is the complete private record hash
extra.source_sha256 and urn/composite source hashes are derived evidence, not raw program HTML
source_ref_binding.query_free_source_note: observed_p1_connection.locator validates a full dated request but RETURNS only scheme/host/path. The receipt supplies the exact request. Matching hashes alone never invent missing race/query/capture metadata.
source_ref_binding.link_to_descriptor: Before lookup, retain unchanged existing native/pair admission and require the supported native cutoff path to equal I['race_cutoff_at'] as an aware instant. Existing captured-input verification binds native race_cutoff_at to pair.race_cutoff_at. Refs only explain that same frozen original; they never replace I or the pair clock.
